HypeSteps

Shoe Concept — Streetwear & Futurism

Moodboard

Brand & Design Analysis

Inspired by Balenciaga's thick segmented sole — a design language that redefines modern luxury through hype-inducing and disruptive streetwear aesthetics.

Ideation

Sketch Explorations

Extensive ideation across minimalist runners, chunky platform sneakers, and high-top streetwear silhouettes, each exploring different sole constructions and material layering.

Final Sketch

The Chosen Direction

Concepts

6 Colourway Concepts

Modern streetwear meets high-fashion aesthetics. Six distinct colourways exploring mesh, suede, and rubber across a chunky layered sole construction.

Final Render

The Final Design

Warm tan and black leather upper with sherpa collar, chunky segmented white sole, and leather strap closure — premium streetwear bridging luxury and performance.

Project 02

Capilla

Self-Watering Planter with Integrated Wireless Charging

Overview

Eliminating "Plant Anxiety"

Capilla merges biophilic nature with modern tech utility. Designed for urban environments like Mumbai, it's a statement art piece for your desk that also charges your phone — eliminating the anxiety of forgetting to water your plants.

Ideation

Concept Explorations

CAD Model

Product Brief & Technical Design

Dual-chamber sub-irrigation with capillary wick mechanism. 200ml reservoir, 7-day water supply, transparent acrylic for visual monitoring. Wireless Qi charging isolated from the water system for safety.

Final Prototype

In the Real World

Mockup

Night Mode

An integrated LED strip illuminates the wooden base when charging — creating a calming, biophilic atmosphere for your bedside or desk.

Project 04

Diya Collection

Lifestyle Design — Diwali Diyas for Aluminum Die Casting

Overview

Diwali, Cast in Aluminum

Diwali diyas, designed for aluminum die casting. A festive, ornamental object reimagined for volume manufacturing — balancing intricate rim detailing with the constraints of high-pressure die casting.

Ideation

Six Rim Concepts

Six rim concepts sketched by hand — floral wreath, bird-wing, leaf scroll, braid, peacock, wave relief. Peacock and leaf-scroll carried forward.

Moodboard

Reference & Proportion

Reference brass and aluminum diyas — lotus rims, fluted bowls, oxidised finishes — used to gauge proportion and detailing.

CAD Model

Modelled for Die Casting

Modelled in Fusion 360 with die-cast constraints checked: draft angle, no sharp edges, minimum fillet radius, minimum wall thickness, parting line.

Physical Prototype

Testing Scale & Ergonomics

3D printed before tooling, to test scale and ergonomics in hand.

Mold Design

Four-Cavity Tooling

Core-and-cavity mold, four-cavity layout. Molten aluminum injected under high pressure, part ejected after cooling.

Final Product

Finished in ADC12 Aluminum

Final parts in ADC12 aluminum, sandblasted finish.

Project 05

ModuKids

Children's Study Table — Furniture That Grows With Kids

Research

Overview, User Needs & Market Trends

Overview

A kids' study table is more than furniture — it's a space that supports learning, creativity, and daily routines. Parents seek safety, adaptability, and longevity. Kids want something engaging and comfortable.

Design Brief

Design modular children's furniture that grows with a child. Height-adjustable desk as the core, with stackable multi-use blocks — built with safe, durable materials promoting independence and active play.

User Needs

  • Parents: Safety first, long-term investment, space-saving, easy maintenance
  • Children: Comfort & ergonomics, fun & engaging, multi-functionality

Market Trends

  • Adjustable & height-adaptable designs
  • Ergonomic focus
  • Modular furniture systems
  • Minimal aesthetic
  • Sustainable materials

Ideation

Concept Sketches & Prototypes

Final Design

Furniture That Grows With Kids
